text: OK Purchase. The curtains do the job. They are unevenly hemmed and one curtain bows at the bottom because of this. The sheets are not as well put together as the picture - even with multiple sheets.

product_metadata.title: No. 918 Emily Sheer Voile Rod Pocket Door Sidelight Curtain Panel, 28" x 72", Charcoal
features: Gently filters light while enhancing privacy
Rod pocket design allows for easy hanging on a standard curtain rod
Complete the look with the matching No. 918 Emily Curtain Collection
Includes 1 single curtain panel and 1 tie-back
description: Add a touch of detail to your doorway with this sheer voile side light curtain panel. Softly filters light while adding privacy to your entry area. Features a rod pocket design for curtain rods up to 0.75". Tie the room together with the coordinating No. 918 Emily Sheer Voile Door Panels for standard patio door windows, or the No. 918 Emily Sheer Voile Sliding Patio Door Panels for extra wide sliding glass doors or double patio doors. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Use non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry on low heat, using a cool iron as needed.
